body.name: \mathcal B_n(c)
body.def: \(\mathcal B_n(c)=\{B_{1,n}(c),\ldots,B_{K_n,n}(c)\}\) is a deterministic interval partition of \([0,1]\) having \(c\) as an endpoint and maximum bin diameter at most \(b_n\).
body.role: defines coarsened four-cell observations without forcing one global bin for every cutoff-grid point
